title: Surface area bound for convex cones
statement: Let $n\ge 0$ and let $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ be measurable and convex. Suppose that whenever $x\in A$ and $t\ge 0$, the scalar multiple $tx$ also belongs to $A$. Then the Gaussian surface area of $A$ is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is closed under multiplication by every nonnegative real scalar
